text:
My memory was images
of you in that instant:
that expression, a shade
in your eyes, something soft

in the inflection of your voice,
and your furtive yawns
like a greyhound that slept poorly
through the night in my room.

To return, after years,
to happiness—
to see each other and remember
that I too have changed.

translation.title: My Memory Was Images...
